name: Band Seated Single-Arm Rotational Row
steps: Sit tall on the floor facing a waist-high band anchor with your legs extended and grip the band in one hand.
Brace your core and let your working arm reach forward toward the anchor with your shoulders square.
Pull your elbow smoothly past your ribs while rotating your chest slightly toward your pulling side.
Unwind and extend your arm slowly back to the start, then switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep both sitting bones planted evenly on the floor rather than leaning back as you pull.
Drive the rotation through your mid-back and obliques instead of jerking your shoulder.
